result.title: OPSRL-SSP: Optimistic Posterior Sampling for Stochastic Shortest Path with Minimax-Optimal Regret
result.summary: We study online reinforcement learning for the stochastic shortest path (SSP) problem with unknown transition dynamics. Although existing posterior-sampling methods perform well empirically on SSPs, their regret guarantees do not achieve the minimax-optimal order. We address this limitation by proposing OPSRL-SSP, an optimistic posterior-sampling algorithm for the SSP setting. The algorithm operates in epochs and uses a logarithmic, time-dependent schedule for the number of posterior samples. To induce optimism, we augment the transition model with a pseudo-state assigned an optimistic boundary value. We establish a high-probability regret bound of $\tilde{O}(B_\star \sqrt{SAK} + B_\star S^2 A)$, where $B_\star$ is an upper bound on the expected cost of the optimal policy, $S$ and $A$ are the numbers of states and actions, respectively, and $K$ is the number of episodes. In addition, we extend the analysis to general zero-cost SSPs using a universal cost-perturbation argument. The leading term matches the minimax lower bound $Ω(B_\star \sqrt{SAK})$, thereby addressing the open problem raised by Jafarnia-Jahromi et al. [19] for posterior sampling in the SSP setting.

AI.brief_summary: 研究未知转移下随机最短路径（SSP）的在线强化学习，提出按轮次运行、采用对数时间相关采样数并借伪状态引入乐观性的后验采样算法 OPSRL-SSP，证明其遗憾阶与 minimax 下界匹配，并推广到零代价 SSP。
AI.relevance_reason: SSP 中的终止成本与「何时停止」决策在概念上可能对应 LVR 的 STOP 收益—成本权衡，乐观后验采样也可供核查作为不确定性下获取证据与分配计算的思路，但属远领域迁移，需阅读原文判断可用性。
